entries.042c19c6d72dec48: This category performs system operation and other work for the services of specific customer companies running on AWS or Google Cloud.
entries.19ca374649030c1f: A cloud-specialized company that provides cloud adoption support, resale, and operational support end to end, centered on AWS.
entries.21b16fa2dcb54abf: This business resells AWS and Google Cloud usage fees. With added value such as billing agency services, the business also includes the AWS operation automation service “Cloud Automator” and sales of software licenses for security measures. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥35,877,350 thousand. G-gen Co., Ltd. handles the resale of Google Cloud.
entries.23b3325533ca3438: This is based on the descriptions under [Business Overview] of implementation support from the early days, consistent service provision, and the accumulation of knowledge and technical training.
entries.2ec03fa24f9dd1d5: This business model provides AWS and Google Cloud services by combining introduction support, resale of usage fees, and operational support.
entries.2fb1ec3e6a65d511: Revenue from usage fees for operational support services
entries.376771187b73a1ec: In April 2025, the company announced its medium-term management policy (FY26-FY28), which centers on the strategic alliance agreement with AWS concluded in 2023 and states that it will work on cloud infrastructure consulting, infrastructure construction and operation, new service development utilizing generative AI, enhancement of added value in the security domain, and overseas expansion through alliances. In addition, it states that it will advance into strategic areas such as managed security services and generative AI-related services, and strengthen its capabilities.
entries.3a877a4d583bf682: This cloud computing business centers on AWS and also handles Google Cloud. It provides cloud adoption support, resale of usage fees, and operational support on an integrated basis. Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥40,006,534 thousand (up 12.0% year on year). Consolidated subsidiary G-gen Co., Ltd. handles the Google Cloud business.
entries.469a4ee8064b2bb2: The group consists of the company, 3 consolidated subsidiaries and 2 affiliates, with 520 consolidated employees (as of February 28, 2026).
entries.556f75f995490693: This business undertakes monitoring, operation and maintenance of servers and networks that customer companies have deployed on AWS or Google Cloud. Operating 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, it performs performance monitoring, fault monitoring and recovery, and backup, and is also advancing MSSP initiatives that include threat monitoring and incident response. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥1,731,316 thousand.
entries.5805a4c63bbde4bb: Net sales for the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥40,006,534 thousand (up 12.0% year on year). By product and service, resale was ¥35,877,350 thousand, cloud integration was ¥2,367,675 thousand, MSP was ¥1,731,316 thousand, and other was ¥30,192 thousand.

entries.951900023497f3fa: Net loss attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥600,957 thousand.

entries.b9e79b44d90b5bd8: Its customers are companies migrating from on-premises environments to the cloud, and companies that continue to use AWS and Google Cloud and seek operational support.
entries.cd5e7fb5f9dbd024: The company provides introductory support, including cloud infrastructure design and construction and application development, as well as reselling AWS and Google Cloud, automation services for operations, and operational support.
entries.d2d6b87eff306ada: Since the early days of cloud computing, before the establishment of AWS's Japanese subsidiary, it has provided AWS implementation support, and it has a structure to consistently handle everything from migration consulting and infrastructure construction to application development and post-migration operational support. It accumulates knowledge gained from numerous implementation track records, uses it in internal technical training, and develops many engineers holding AWS certifications.
entries.de271d2ae515c92b: While the domestic cloud market continues to grow, the company operates as a cloud-only integrator centered on AWS. The business consists of a single segment, the Cloud Business. Of external customer net sales of ¥40,006,534 thousand for the fiscal year ended February 2026, resale accounted for the majority at ¥35,877,350 thousand. No single customer accounts for 10% or more of net sales.
